description: Type the 400 a semantic governance policy create answers while its agent isn't visible yet. Observed live 2026-10-30: one second after the agent's create operation finished, create answered 400 'Agent projects/{number}/locations/global/agents/{id} not found.' It surfaced as an out-of-union BadRequest. The agent becomes visible within seconds, so callers retry.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The policy's agent doesn't exist, or isn't visible yet just after its create (HTTP 400: 'Agent ... not found.').
